Dominating set.subject: Computer & IT
Dominating set.question: The _____ was Subset of a graph's nodes such that all other nodes link to at least one.
Dominating set.fact: In graph theory, a dominating set for a graph G is a subset D of its vertices, such that any vertex of G is in D, or has a neighbor in D. The domination number γ(G) is the number of vertices in a smallest dominating set for G. The dominating set problem concerns testing whether γ(G) ≤ K for a given graph G and input K; it is a classical NP-complete decision problem in computational complexity theory. Dominating sets are of practical interest in several areas.
